items.quote:
came to Jehoiada the priest.
10  Then he gave the commanders the spears and shields
items.contrast: Jehoiada is the giver, whereas the commanders receive the weapons.
items.reason: The commanders come to Jehoiada, and the next sentence says that “he” gives the weapons to them. Resolving the pronoun identifies Jehoiada rather than the commanders as the actor.
